# Still Out There — Berry Bowl Scene Asset Pack

This pack was extracted from the supplied Berry Bowl scene screenshot.

## Included
- `00_Original_Scene_Reference.png` — original screenshot, unchanged.
- `01_Child_Astronaut_Transparent_APPROX.png` — approximate transparent child cutout.
- `02_Oppy_Rover_Transparent_APPROX.png` — approximate transparent Oppy rover cutout.
- `03_Mars_Landscape_Background_Reference.png` — Mars landscape reference.
- `04_Berry_Bowl_Rock_Crop.png` — rock with the small spherical formations.
- `05_Berry_Bowl_Magnified_Detail_Crop.png` — magnified berry detail.
- `06_Berry_Bowl_Title_Parchment_Crop.png` — scene title parchment.
- `07_Story_Text_Parchment_Crop.png` — main story text panel.
- `08_Question_Highlight_Crop.png` — question strip.
- `09_Need_Measurement_Button_Crop.png` — measurement prompt button.
- `10_Top_Progress_And_Navigation_Crop.png` — progress/navigation bar.
- `11_Case_Title_Header_Crop.png` — case title header.
- `12_Berry_Bowl_Name_Tag_Crop.png` — Berry Bowl label.
- `13_Clickable_Berry_Hotspot_Crop.png` — visual reference for the clickable rock hotspot.
- `14_Rover_And_Child_Interaction_Crop.png` — child and rover composition reference.

## Important limitation
The source screenshot is flattened, not a layered design file. The child and rover transparent PNGs are approximate automatic extractions and may contain background remnants or lose fine edges. The other items are rectangular crops and may include overlapping pixels.

For the live website, rebuild text, buttons, navigation, progress, labels, and clickable hotspots as real React/CSS components. Use these assets as visual references. Preserve the supplied child and Oppy designs, proportions, facial features, and the original warm Mars color palette. The berry hotspot should enlarge/reveal the detail when clicked; do not bake the interaction into a static image.
